reviews.text: Tom, Marshall, and Sandy at Palm Springs Pool Service make an exquisite team! Tom got our pool leak fixed, assembled a team to install our motorized pool cover, and is always available to answer any questions that I have. I remember an instance leading up to the pool leak where our chlorine content was low and Marshall took care of it right away. I HIGHLY recommend this company for ANY of your pool needs!
reviews.author: Dai Chu

reviews.text: Tom came out to fix my Raypak pool heater as an authorized repairer - he was friendly, and quickly diagnosed and fixed the problem (loose connection). He also noticed that the installer had neglected to put in a sediment trap, and I was able to call the installer and get them to do it.
reviews.author: Sam Banerjee

reviews.text: I wish that I had come in contact with Tom and Palm Springs Pool Service years ago! In the past three weeks I needed several pool issues addressed quickly and efficiently. I needed them fixed correctly in one shot as a prior pool inspection had overlooked them. Tom's assessment of the problems was spot on in all instances. From a new Raypak pool heater that would not fire to a spa blower that would not blow to other items in between (leaking equipment, etc.), Tom had everything up and running in short order. He was very straight forward about what he believed to be the causes of the problems and up front about costs and time required to repair. I strongly recommend Palm Springs Pool Service for your pool repair and pool inspection needs.
reviews.author: M S

reviews.text: I have been doing business with Palm Springs for over 20 years. I always get great service. Tom Dittman always answers my questions. I got a new Polaris pump this time.
reviews.author: Beverly Beach

reviews.text: Customer service is pretty solid with reasonable price. They really work with you also. Great small company with very personable staff
reviews.author: Alec Butcher

results.title: Palm Springs Pool Service Reviews - Garland, TX | HomeAdvisor
results.snippet: At Palm Springs Pool Service, we are dedicated to offering high caliber swimming pool and hot tub installations to customers in Garland, TX.

data.summary: Reviews show mixed authenticity. Positive Google reviews are detailed and credible but old (5-7 years). Recent sentiment appears negative based on Yelp rating and recent 1-star Google review. The 47-year-old business has surprisingly few reviews, suggesting possible review management. The story suggests a possible decline in service quality or customer relations over time.
fake_signals: Google reviews clustered in older timeframe (5-7 years ago)
Lack of recent detailed positive reviews on Google
Possible review suppression on Google given only 7 reviews for a 47-year-old business
authentic_signals: Detailed project descriptions (pool leak, heater repair, motorized cover)
Varied writing styles and specific timelines
data.discrepancy_explanation: Significant rating gap between Google (3.9) and Yelp (2.9). Google reviews are older (5-7 years) and positive, while Yelp's lower score suggests more recent or different customer experiences. BBB A+ rating is based on complaint handling, not service quality.
